items.title: Buddy DeFranco interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: Dodo Marmarosa... was on all of the bands that I’ve played with including Tommy Dorsey. He was with Artie Shaw as well.

ctx.x: Your first experience in bebop, where did that take place? Back in New York?

Yeah. Back in New York. I had not worked with Charlie Shavers at the time but we knew Charlie pretty well and met him on Broadway. When I say “we,” Dodo Marmarosa, who was quite a piano player. I would say at fourteen years old he was one of the best in the world, jazz piano player, who also recorded with Bird and was on all of the bands that I’ve played with including Tommy Dorsey. He was with Artie Shaw as well. Dodo Marmarosa. Artie loved his playing. But he and I ran into Charlie Shavers. And Charlie Shavers…
It takes an awful lot of facility to pull that off.
